properties.title: Tornado Warning issued August 3 at 9:23PM MST until August 3 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 923 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Topawa, moving west at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

This tornado will be near...
Topawa around 925 PM MST.

Other locations impacted by the tornado include Vamori, Cowlic and
Itak.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Tornadoes are difficult to observe at night. Take cover now!

properties.title: Dust Storm Warning issued August 3 at 9:22PM MST until August 3 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
At 922 PM MST, a wall of dust was along a line extending from 6 miles
north of Florence to near Magma to near Blackwater to 10 miles
northwest of Chui-Chu, moving northwest at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Less than one quarter mile visibility with strong wind in
excess of 50 mph.

SOURCE...Doppler radar.

IMPACT...Dangerous life-threatening travel.

This includes the following highways...
AZ Interstate 10 between mile markers 182 and 204.
AZ Interstate 8 between mile markers 169 and 178.
AZ Route 87 between mile markers 124 and 149.

Locations impacted include...
Casa Grande, Florence, Coolidge, Arizona City, La Palma, Blackwater,
Toltec, Magma, Coolidge Airport, Arizola, Randolph, Valley Farms, and
Sacaton.
properties.instruction:
Dust storms lead to dangerous driving conditions with visibility
reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, then pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

Motorists should not drive into a dust storm. PULL ASIDE STAY ALIVE!

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 9:18PM MST until August 4 at 12:15AM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1215 AM MST.

* At 918 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area, primarily in the Tohono O'odham
Nation. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Topawa, San Miguel, Vamori, South Komelik, Cowlic, Choulic,
Newfield, Coldfields, Sasabe, Fresnal Canyon and Hashan Chuchg.

This includes Route 286 between mile markers 1 and 13.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Indian Route 19 south of Topawa.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Lopez Wash, Chutum Vaya Wash, Santa Margarita Wash, Vamori Wash,
Moras Wash, Las, Sasabe, Arroyo del, Thomas Canyon Wash, Legunita
Wash, Baboquivari Wash, Puertocito Wash, Compartidero, Arroyo del,
Topawa Wash, Canoa Wash, Fresnal Wash, Big Wash, Fresno Wash,
Sabino Wash, Ali Molina Wash, Contreras Wash, Mulberry Wash, Altar
Wash, Placeritos Wash, Solano Wash, Bailey Wash, Little Thomas Wash
and Osa Wash, La.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 3 at 9:15PM MST until August 3 at 10:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1015 PM MST.

* At 915 PM MST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
15 miles northwest of San Isidro to near San Miguel, moving west at
25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sells, Santa Rosa, Topawa, Pisinemo, San Miguel, San Isidro, Ali
Chukson, Covered Wells, Gu Oidak, Vamori, South Komelik, Cowlic,
Fresnal, Choulic, Newfield, Ak Chin, Coldfields, No:ligk, Cababi
and Comobabi.

This includes Route 86 between mile markers 78 and 127.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds and
large hail.

Intense thunderstorm lines can produce brief tornadoes and widespread
significant wind damage. Although a tornado is not immediately
likely, it is best to move to an interior room on the lowest floor of
a building. These storms may cause serious injury and significant
property damage.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.description:

Lawrenceville, Dolphin, Edgerton, Prices Mill, Warfield,

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 3 at 8:13PM CDT until August 5 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Wednesday afternoon and continue falling to 7.1 feet Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 17.9
feet on 11/04/1985.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.title: Air Quality Alert issued August 3 at 11:03AM MDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
AQAMSO

* WHAT...Air Quality Advisory due to smoke from wildfires.

Air Quality Index ranging from good to moderate, but is forecasted to degrade.

* WHERE...All Areas on the Nez Perce Reservation.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

* IMPACTS...Those who experience health effects from smoke include
children under 18, elders, pregnant women, people with asthma
or have difficulty breathing, diabetes, heart problems or
otherwise compromised health, and people who have high exposure
(those who work, exercise, or spend extensive time outdoors).
properties.instruction:
Under the most severe pollution level, sensitive groups should avoid
outdoor exposure and limit indoor activities, and everyone should
restrict their outdoor activities.

Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
https://healthandwelfare.idaho.gov/health-wellness/environmental-
health/wildfire-smoke
Idaho Smoke Information Hotline: 1-800-345-1007
